content.title: Contact Proof to Substrate Breach | Repetition Establishes the Rule
content.summary: First, a steady pace repeatedly triggers the same local surface reaction, establishing rules with countable contacts; then a stronger contact causes irreversible rupture of the bearing surface, and the lens crosses the same boundary into the lower world and ends in a new medium state.

quick_start.input_format: Single body and continuous bearing surface + at least 3 countable contact reactions + 1 irreversible rupture + same boundary crossing + final state of the underlying medium
quick_start.recommended_input: The fungus courier walked through the transparent pollen film. The first four times he landed, some branches and leaf veins were produced, and the fifth time caused the film surface to fold and tear; the camera followed from the same breach into the luminous root chamber and maintained the new medium.
required_anchors: Establish one subject, one travel direction and one continuous support surface.
Repeat the same localized response at multiple contact points.
Make one contact irreversibly breach the previously proven support rule.
Carry the camera through the same boundary and hold the new medium.
usage_steps: Replace the example subject, setting, and surface details with an original concept.
Keep every required anchor and Creative DNA invariant causally visible.
Choose the MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 prompt and fill only the declared variable slots.
Check duration, event order, camera continuity, sound, and anti-copy constraints before generation.
applicable_scope: First, a steady pace repeatedly triggers the same local surface reaction, establishing rules with countable contacts; then a stronger contact causes irreversible rupture of the bearing surface, and the lens crosses the same boundary into the lower world and ends in a new medium state.
Original 4–15 second concepts that can preserve every required anchor.
MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 projects that need a reusable causal video structure.
not_suitable_for: Requests that copy the source identity, setting, props, dialogue, or shot order.
Concepts that cannot show all required anchors inside the target duration.
Long-form exposition or unrelated multi-location stories without a compact causal chain.

creative_dna.mechanism: A support-surface transformation is earned by first proving a repeatable contact rule several times, then breaking that exact rule with one stronger contact. The camera must cross the same physical boundary so the lower environment reads as a consequence, and the ending should hold the new medium rather than immediately resetting.

invariants.purpose: Defines the geometry whose rule will be tested.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without a stable surface, later rupture feels arbitrary.

invariants.ablation_failure: One decorative reaction cannot establish a rule.

invariants.purpose: Builds pressure without changing the premise.
invariants.ablation_failure: Unrelated effects replace escalation with montage.

slots.name: lead_subject
slots.constraint: An original stable subject or pair with a readable role.

slots.name: setting
slots.constraint: A new setting with fixed spatial anchors and no source-specific surface.

slots.name: escalation_variable
slots.constraint: One causal variable that changes through visible stages.

slots.name: performance_rule
slots.constraint: A restrained acting or motion rule that keeps the mechanism legible.

slots.name: camera_grammar
slots.constraint: An information order that proves each state without copying source shot boundaries.

slots.name: payoff
slots.constraint: A clean final physical, informational or social consequence.

slots.name: sound_family
slots.constraint: An original hierarchy of diegetic cues; no unsupported source-audio claim.

instantiations.concept: A lone fungal courier walks across a translucent pollen membrane in a greenhouse dome. Four footsteps send branching veins through the membrane; the fifth folds it inward and the courier descends into a glowing root chamber as the camera follows through the same tear.

instantiations.concept: A magnetic inspection sphere rolls across a taut ferromagnetic membrane inside a coil laboratory. Four passes leave directional ridge patterns rather than footprints; the fifth high-torque contact punctures the membrane, and a rotating inspection camera follows the sphere through the same opening into a lower induction-coil chamber.
